style: Create original high-fantasy game art with chunky hand-inked dark contours, flat gouache-like color masses and restrained dry-brush texture, matching a painted dragon-and-kingdom deckbuilder; heroic with a light touch of wonder. CARD art shows the power of an original boy spellblade through his parts and effects: an ornate silver vambrace on his right forearm projecting a straight blade of pale-blue light, glowing pale-blue mana orbs, navy coat sleeves with silver trim, blue runes, crystal shards and blue arcane spells; plus the clockwork golem enemies, enchanted forest ruins and weathered stone. When the spellblade appears, show only his gloved hand, vambrace, light blade, coat sleeve, or a small silhouette from behind; never draw his face. Palette: deep navy #1B2A55, sapphire, ice cyan, pale-blue light #7FD3FF, silver steel and white, with mossy greens and weathered stone in the scenery; absolutely no purple or violet. Bold readable silhouettes, two-step cel shading and selective cool highlights; reserve soft emission for light blades, mana, runes and VFX. Do not imitate any existing game, champion, franchise character, emblem or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, emblems, watermarks or typographic symbols, and respect each asset's stated background and framing requirements.
